Method of Attack: Remote code execution vulnerability in Spring Core Java framework allowing arbitrary command execution and full system control
Impacted Systems: Spring MVC apps running on JDK 9+
Spring WebFlux apps running on JDK 9+
VMware Tanzu Application Service for VMs versions 2.10 to 2.13
VMware Tanzu Operations Manager versions 2.8 to 2.9
VMware Tanzu Kubernetes Grid Integrated Edition versions 1.11 to 1.13
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Spring Core Java framework vulnerability via Tomcat WAR deployment
